name: auto_enable_rls
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.auto_enable_rls()
 RETURNS event_trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
  obj record;
begin
  for obj in
    select * from pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands()
    where command_tag = 'CREATE TABLE'
      and schema_name = 'public'
  loop
    execute format('alter table %s enable row level security;', obj.object_identity);
  end loop;
end;
$function$

name: award_history_intel_slice
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.award_history_intel_slice(p_country text, p_since date, p_limit integer DEFAULT 30000)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) - 'running' order by x.award_date desc, x.id), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select h.id, h.source, h.board_ref, h.title, h.buyer, h.winner_business_name, h.winner_is_individual,
           h.value, h.currency, h.country, h.province, h.city, h.award_date, h.end_date, h.end_date_source,
           h.potential_end_date, h.number_of_bids, h.trade_slugs, h.notice_url, h.attribution,
           exists (select 1 from public.bid_results b where b.award_history_id = h.id) as has_bids,
           coalesce(h.end_date >= current_date - 365, false) as running
    from public.award_history h
    where h.country = p_country
      and (h.award_date >= p_since or h.end_date >= current_date - 365)
    order by running desc, h.award_date desc, h.id
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 30000), 1), 60000)
  ) x;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.forum_ratings_changed()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare tid uuid;
begin
  tid := coalesce(new.thread_id, old.thread_id);
  update public.forum_threads t set
    rating_sum = (select coalesce(sum(score), 0) from public.forum_thread_ratings where thread_id = tid),
    rating_count = (select count(*) from public.forum_thread_ratings where thread_id = tid)
  where t.id = tid;
  return null;
end $function$

name: forum_refresh_category

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.forum_refresh_category(cid uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  update public.forum_categories c set
    thread_count = (select count(*) from public.forum_threads t where t.category_id = cid and t.status = 'approved'),
    post_count = (select count(*) + coalesce(sum(t.reply_count), 0) from public.forum_threads t where t.category_id = cid and t.status = 'approved'),
    last_post_at = (select max(t.last_post_at) from public.forum_threads t where t.category_id = cid and t.status = 'approved'),
    last_thread_id = (select t.id from public.forum_threads t where t.category_id = cid and t.status = 'approved' order by t.last_post_at desc limit 1)
  where c.id = cid;
end $function$

name: forum_refresh_profile
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.forum_refresh_profile(uid uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  update public.forum_profiles p set
    post_count = (select count(*) from public.forum_threads where author_id = uid and status = 'approved')
               + (select count(*) from public.forum_posts where author_id = uid and status = 'approved'),
    reputation = case when p.is_system then 0
                 else (select coalesce(sum(points), 0) from public.forum_reputation_events where user_id = uid) end
  where p.user_id = uid;
end $function$

name: forum_refresh_thread
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.forum_refresh_thread(tid uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  n integer; w integer; last_at timestamptz; last_user uuid;
begin
  select count(*), coalesce(sum(body_words), 0) into n, w
    from public.forum_posts where thread_id = tid and status = 'approved';
  select created_at, author_id into last_at, last_user
    from public.forum_posts where thread_id = tid and status = 'approved'
    order by created_at desc limit 1;
  update public.forum_threads t set
    reply_count = n,
    words_total = t.body_words + w,
    last_post_at = coalesce(last_at, t.created_at),
    last_post_user_id = coalesce(last_user, t.author_id)
  where t.id = tid;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  requested text := nullif(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'primary_role', '');
begin
  insert into public.users_profile (id, email, full_name, primary_role)
  values (
    new.id,
    coalesce(new.email, ''),
    coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', ''),
    case
      when requested in ('trade', 'property_manager', 'supplier', 'real_estate_agent', 'visitor', 'talent') then requested
      else 'trade'
    end
  )
  on conflict (id) do nothing;
  return new;
end;
$function$

name: has_active_trade_access
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_active_trade_access(uid uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.organization_members om
    join public.organizations o on o.id = om.organization_id
    join public.subscriptions s on s.organization_id = o.id
    where om.user_id = uid
      and o.organization_type in ('trade_company','supplier')
      and o.status <> 'suspended'
      and s.status in ('active','comped')
      and s.tier in ('pro','featured')
  )
  or exists (
    select 1
    from public.organization_members om
    join public.organizations o on o.id = om.organization_id
    join public.trade_trials t on t.organization_id = o.id
    where om.user_id = uid
      and o.organization_type = 'trade_company'
      and o.status <> 'suspended'
      and t.ends_at > now()
  );
$function$

    join public.intel_access i on i.organization_id = o.id
    where om.user_id = uid

normalize_email
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.normalize_email(e text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
AS $function$
  select case
    when split_part(lower(btrim(coalesce(e, ''))), '@', 2) in ('gmail.com', 'googlemail.com')
      then replace(split_part(split_part(lower(btrim(e)), '@', 1), '+', 1), '.', '') || '@gmail.com'
    else lower(btrim(coalesce(e, '')))
  end
$function$

definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_badge_hits(p_rows jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  insert into public.badge_hits as b (day, kind, slug, referrer, hits)
  select day, kind, slug, referrer, sum(n)::int
  from (
    select
      coalesce((r->>'day')::date, (now() at time zone 'America/Toronto')::date) as day,
      r->>'kind' as kind,
      left(r->>'slug', 120) as slug,
      left(lower(coalesce(r->>'referrer', '')), 120) as referrer,
      greatest(0, least(100000, coalesce((r->>'n')::int, 0))) as n
    from jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof(p_rows) = 'array' then p_rows else '[]'::jsonb end) as r
    where r->>'kind' in ('listed', 'winner', 'karma') and coalesce(r->>'slug', '') <> ''
  ) x
  group by day, kind, slug, referrer
  on conflict (day, kind, slug, referrer)
  do update set hits = b.hits + excluded.hits;
$function$

name: record_landings
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_landings(p_rows jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  insert into public.landing_counts as l (day, channel, landing_path, visits)
  -- Same key twice in one batch is summed first (ON CONFLICT can't touch a row twice).
  select day, channel, landing_path, sum(n)::int
  from (
    select
      coalesce((r->>'day')::date, (now() at time zone 'America/Toronto')::date) as day,
      left(r->>'channel', 40) as channel,
      left(coalesce(r->>'path', ''), 120) as landing_path,
      greatest(0, least(100000, coalesce((r->>'n')::int, 0))) as n
    from jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof(p_rows) = 'array' then p_rows else '[]'::jsonb end) as r
    where coalesce(r->>'channel', '') <> ''
  ) x
  group by day, channel, landing_path
  on conflict (day, channel, landing_path)
  do update set visits = l.visits + excluded.visits;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_sponsor_click(p_sponsor text, p_placement text, p_trade text DEFAULT ''::text, p_region text DEFAULT ''::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  insert into public.sponsor_clicks (sponsor, placement, trade, region, clicks)
  values (left(p_sponsor, 40), left(p_placement, 40), left(coalesce(p_trade, ''), 60), left(coalesce(p_region, ''), 60), 1)
  on conflict (day, sponsor, placement, trade, region)
  do update set clicks = public.sponsor_clicks.clicks + 1;
$function$

name: record_sponsor_impressions
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_sponsor_impressions(p_rows jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  insert into public.sponsor_impressions as si (day, sponsor, placement, trade, region, impressions)
  -- Same key twice in one batch is summed first (ON CONFLICT can't touch a row twice).
  select day, sponsor, placement, trade, region, sum(n)::int
  from (
    select
      coalesce((r->>'day')::date, (now() at time zone 'America/Toronto')::date) as day,
      left(r->>'sponsor', 40) as sponsor,
      left(r->>'placement', 40) as placement,
      left(coalesce(r->>'trade', ''), 60) as trade,
      left(coalesce(r->>'region', ''), 60) as region,
      greatest(0, least(100000, coalesce((r->>'n')::int, 0))) as n
    from jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof(p_rows) = 'array' then p_rows else '[]'::jsonb end) as r
    where coalesce(r->>'sponsor', '') <> '' and coalesce(r->>'placement', '') <> ''
  ) b
  group by day, sponsor, placement, trade, region
  on conflict (day, sponsor, placement, trade, region)
  do update set impressions = si.impressions + excluded.impressions;
$function$

SELECT buyer_slug,
    scope,
    status,
    method,
    granted_on
   FROM buyer_permissions;

SELECT r.slug,
    k.level
   FROM (rfp_posts r
     JOIN org_karma_public k ON ((k.org_id = r.posted_by_organization_id)))
  WHERE ((r.status = 'published'::text) AND (r.source_type = 'gc_package'::text) AND (k.level >= 2));

SELECT id,
    org_id,
    kind,
    points,
    source_type,
    source_id,
    reason,
    created_at,
    reversed_at,
    reversed_reason
   FROM karma_events e
  WHERE (is_org_member(auth.uid(), org_id) OR is_admin(auth.uid()));

SELECT source,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((NOT stale) AND major_project_is_public(source, approved, review_status))) AS live,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE stale) AS stale,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (review_status = 'pending'::text)) AS pending,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (review_status = 'rejected'::text)) AS hidden,
    max(last_seen) AS last_seen
   FROM major_projects
  WHERE is_admin(auth.uid())
  GROUP BY source;

SELECT id,
    slug,
    source,
    country,
    name,
    description,
    category,
    owner,
    city,
    province,
    region_id,
    est_value_cad,
    size,
    status,
    status_raw,
    status_date,
    timeline,
    trades_needed,
    sources,
    license,
    evidence,
    caveats,
    first_seen,
    last_seen,
    stale,
    stale_since,
    status_changed_at,
    updated_at,
    (general_contractor IS NOT NULL) AS has_gc,
    ((bid_list_url IS NOT NULL) OR (bid_route IS NOT NULL)) AS has_bid_route,
    source_updated,
    link_group
   FROM major_projects
  WHERE major_project_is_public(source, approved, review_status);

SELECT k.org_id,
    k.level
   FROM (org_karma k
     JOIN organizations o ON ((o.id = k.org_id)))
  WHERE ((o.profile_status = 'approved'::text) AND (o.status = 'active'::text) AND (NOT o.is_demo));

SELECT oreg.region_id,
    ocat.category_id,
    count(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_org_count
   FROM ((organizations o
     JOIN organization_regions oreg ON ((oreg.organization_id = o.id)))
     JOIN organization_categories ocat ON ((ocat.organization_id = o.id)))
  WHERE ((o.organization_type = ANY (ARRAY['trade_company'::text, 'supplier'::text])) AND (o.status = 'active'::text) AND (o.profile_status = 'approved'::text) AND (COALESCE(o.is_demo, false) = false))
  GROUP BY oreg.region_id, ocat.category_id;

SELECT oreg.region_id,
    count(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_org_count
   FROM (organizations o
     JOIN organization_regions oreg ON ((oreg.organization_id = o.id)))
  WHERE ((o.organization_type = ANY (ARRAY['trade_company'::text, 'supplier'::text])) AND (o.status = 'active'::text) AND (o.profile_status = 'approved'::text) AND (COALESCE(o.is_demo, false) = false))
  GROUP BY oreg.region_id;

SELECT slug,
    source_url
   FROM rfp_posts
  WHERE ((status = 'published'::text) AND (source_type = 'public_source'::text) AND (source_url IS NOT NULL) AND (slug ~ '-(cba|qca|tora|nsa)-[a-z0-9-]+$'::text) AND (summary ~~ 'Awarded %'::text) AND (deadline <= CURRENT_DATE));

SELECT id,
    title,
    slug,
    summary,
    property_type_id,
    region_id,
    city,
    province,
    deadline,
    desired_start_date,
    source_type,
    is_demo,
    published_at,
    created_at,
    gc_project_name,
    awarded_rfp_id
   FROM rfp_posts
  WHERE (status = 'published'::text);

SELECT id,
    slug,
    tier,
    country,
    trades,
    regions,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    status,
        CASE
            WHEN (status = 'approved'::text) THEN name
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS name,
        CASE
            WHEN (status = 'approved'::text) THEN logo_url
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS logo_url,
        CASE
            WHEN (status = 'approved'::text) THEN url
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS url,
        CASE
            WHEN (status = 'approved'::text) THEN headline
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS headline,
        CASE
            WHEN (status = 'approved'::text) THEN message
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS message,
        CASE
            WHEN (status = 'approved'::text) THEN cta
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS cta,
        CASE
            WHEN (status = 'approved'::text) THEN headline_fr
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS headline_fr,
        CASE
            WHEN (status = 'approved'::text) THEN message_fr
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS message_fr,
        CASE
            WHEN (status = 'approved'::text) THEN cta_fr
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS cta_fr
   FROM sponsors
  WHERE ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'approved'::text, 'paused'::text])) AND ((end_date IS NULL) OR (end_date >= (((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto'::text))::date - 1))));

SELECT r.id,
    r.organization_id,
    r.case_study_id,
        CASE
            WHEN r.show_building THEN btrim(r.reviewer_name)
            ELSE regexp_replace(btrim(r.reviewer_name), '^(\S+)\s+(\S).*$'::text, '\1 \2.'::text)
        END AS reviewer_display_name,
        CASE
            WHEN r.show_building THEN r.reviewer_company
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS reviewer_company,
    r.rating,
    r.body,
    r.verified_via,
    r.reply,
    r.reply_at,
    r.created_at
   FROM (vendor_reviews r
     LEFT JOIN case_studies cs ON ((cs.id = r.case_study_id)))
  WHERE ((r.status = 'published'::text) AND ((r.case_study_id IS NULL) OR (cs.visibility IS DISTINCT FROM 'private'::text)));

SELECT c.winner_slug,
    o.name,
    o.slug AS org_slug,
    o.logo_url,
    o.short_description,
    o.website,
        CASE
            WHEN (o.public_contact_visibility = 'show_contact'::text) THEN o.phone
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS phone,
        CASE
            WHEN (o.public_contact_visibility = 'show_contact'::text) THEN o.email
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS email,
    o.city,
    o.province,
    o.verified,
    c.reviewed_at AS claimed_at
   FROM (winner_claims c
     JOIN organizations o ON ((o.id = c.organization_id)))
  WHERE ((c.status = 'approved'::text) AND (o.profile_status = 'approved'::text) AND (o.status = 'active'::text) AND (NOT o.is_demo));

sql: create extension if not exists pgcrypto;      -- gen_random_uuid()
create extension if not exists pg_trgm;       -- trigram search
create index organizations_name_trgm on public.organizations using gin (name gin_trgm_ops);
create index organizations_desc_trgm on public.organizations using gin (short_description gin_trgm_ops);
create index rfp_posts_title_trgm on public.rfp_posts using gin (title gin_trgm_ops);
create index rfp_posts_summary_trgm on public.rfp_posts using gin (summary gin_trgm_ops);

create index if not exists region_requests_name_trgm
  on public.region_requests using gin (raw_name gin_trgm_ops);
create index if not exists award_history_trades_idx on public.award_history using gin (trade_slugs);
